Write a story about: A kind and generous deer with big horns meets a little rabbit and they start to play, but the deer forgets about his big horns and accidentally hurts the rabbit, leaving the deer sad and lonely.
With: sad ending
response:
"Hello, little rabbit," said the deer. "Do you want to play with me?"
The rabbit looked at the deer's big horns and said, "Yes, I want to play with you. But can you be careful with your big horns?"
The deer nodded his head and they started to play. They were spinning around and around, laughing and having fun. But the deer forgot about his big horns.
As they were playing, the deer's big horns hit the rabbit. The rabbit was very sad and hurt. The deer felt very bad for what he had done.
In the end, the rabbit had to go away and find a new friend to play with. The generous deer was left all alone, sad and lonely, because he did not remember to be careful with his big horns.

Write a story about: Lily is excited to welcome a new baby into her family and prepares a special box with toys and a brush for her new sibling. When her baby brother Sam is born, Lily is thrilled to meet him and show him the special box.
With: happy ending
response:

One day, Lily's mommy and daddy went to the hospital to have the baby. Lily stayed with her grandma and grandpa. When Lily's mommy and daddy came back home, they had a little baby boy with them. Lily was so happy to meet her new baby brother, Sam. She showed him the special box with the brush and toys she had saved for him. Sam's mommy used the brush to gently brush his dry, soft hair. Lily knew that she would be the best big sister ever and couldn't wait to play with Sam and Max together.

With: sad ending
response:

Write a story about: A couple tries to teach their 3-year-old to count by ordering pizza, but the child only counts up to four before forgetting when the pizza arrives, leaving the parents disappointed and the child feeling like a big zero.
With: sad ending
response:
Once there was a mum and dad who wanted to teach their 3 year old how to count. They decided to try and order some food to see if it would work. So they ordered pizza.
The mum and dad were very proud when the 3 year old counted all the way up to four! But when the pizza arrived, the 3 year old counted only to zero! The mum and dad were very disappointed.
The 3 year old started to cry because it felt bad when the mum and dad were not proud. It felt like a big zero inside its stomach.
The mum and dad still love the 3 year old very much, but the 3 year old was sad and never learned to count again.

With: sad ending
response:

They got lost in the park. It was getting dark. Tim and Sue were scared. They tried to find the way home, but they could not. They cried and wished they had not forgotten the map. The end.
Summary: Tim and Sue go for a jog in the park, get lost because Tim forgets the map, and become scared and unable to find their way home.

With: sad ending
response:
Then, they saw a big house. Lily said, "Can we visit the house?" Her mom said, "No, we can't. It's not our house." 
Suddenly, a big storm came. They tried to find a place to hide, but they couldn't. They got very wet and cold. Lily said, "This is not perfect." Her mom said, "I know. Let's go home."

Write a story about: Lissa, a three-year-old girl, buys a pill hoping it would make her lucky, but it doesn't work and she becomes sad.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lissa. She was three years old, and loved playing with her friends.
One day, Lissa did something very special. She decided to buy a pill. She didn't have enough money, so she asked her mum to help. Her mum said that she had enough and they went to the shop together. 
Lissa was so excited to finally buy her pill. She thought that it would make her lucky. But when they got home, they saw that the pill didn't work at all.
Lissa was very sad and started to cry. She asked her mum if they could buy another pill, but her mum said no. She said it was time to go to bed and try to forget about silly pills.
Lissa was very disappointed and went to bed. She was never lucky, not even that day.

With: happy ending
response:
Tim was brave and climbed the tree. He said to the cat, "Don't worry, I will help you!" The cat meowed, and Tim carefully picked it up. They both went down the tree together.
When they were on the ground, the cat was very happy. It said, "Meow, thank you, Tim!" Tim felt good for being brave and helping the cat. They became best friends and played together every day.
Summary: Tim rescues a cat stuck in a tree and they become best friends.

Write a story about: Spot the dog tries to balance his ball on a tree branch despite warnings from his wise friend, the owl, and ends up hurting himself, learning the lesson to listen to wise advice.
With: sad ending
response:
Spot tried to balance the ball on the branch, but it was very hard. He tried and tried, but the ball kept falling off. Spot's friend, a wise old owl, told him to be careful. The owl said, "Spot, if you keep trying to balance the ball on the branch, you might get hurt."
But Spot did not listen to the wise old owl. He wanted to balance the ball on the branch more than anything. So, he kept trying. Finally, the ball stayed on the branch, and Spot was very happy.
Spot jumped up to get the ball, but he fell. He hurt his leg very badly. The wise old owl saw Spot and said, "I told you to be careful, but you did not listen." Spot was sad and wished he had listened to his friend.
The moral of the story is that we should always listen to the advice of wise friends. They can help us avoid bad things from happening.

Write a story about: Max hurts his leg while playing in the park, and his owner takes him to the veterinarian who helps him recover. However, Max hurts his leg again while trying to play with a cat and is unable to recover, leading to a sad ending.
With: sad ending
response: One day, Max saw a cat in the park. Max wanted to play with the cat, but the cat didn't want to play with Max. Max tried to play with the cat anyway, and he chased the cat. The cat ran up a tree, and Max tried to reach the cat by stretching his legs. Max stretched and stretched, but he couldn't reach the cat. Suddenly, Max lost his balance and fell from the tree. Max's leg hurt again, and he couldn't run anymore. Max's owner took him back to the veterinarian, but this time, the veterinarian couldn't help Max. Max's leg was too badly hurt, and he had to say goodbye to his owner.

Write a story about: Crabby the crab hides too well during a game of hide and seek with his friends, causing them to worry until they find him under a rock. He promises to never hide for too long again.
With: happy ending
response:
After a while, Crabby's friends started to yell his name. "Crabby, where are you?" they shouted. But Crabby didn't answer. His friends got worried and started to search for him. 
Finally, they found Crabby hiding under a rock. "You scared us, Crabby!" his friends said. "Sorry," Crabby replied. "I just wanted to win the game." 
From then on, Crabby promised to never hide for too long. He wanted to keep his friends happy and jolly. They all swam back home together, laughing and playing in the sea.
Summary: Crabby the crab hides too well during a game of hide and seek with his friends, causing them to worry until they find him under a rock. He promises to never hide for too long again.

Write a story about: A fat frog and a cricket become friends and play together until the sun goes down.
With: happy ending
response:
Once, there was a fat frog. He hopped around the ground, happy and carefree. One day, he stopped. He was happy to welcome his friend, a cricket! The frog opened his mouth wide and made happy ribbits. 
The cricket responded and they started hopping around together. They hopped around the ground and under the leaves. They plopped on the ground, happy and content.
The cricket patted the frog on his back and the frog smiled. They played together until the sun went down. When it became dark, the frog said goodbye to his friend. The frog thanked the cricket for being such a good friend and for welcoming him so warmly. 
The cricket waved goodbye and hopped off into the night. The frog watched as the cricket departed and then curled up on the ground and fell asleep, happy and content.

With: happy ending
response:

But one day, a little bird flew into the garden with the princess's veil in its beak. The princess was overjoyed and hugged the little bird. She thanked it for returning her valued veil. From that day on, the princess made sure to always keep her veil safe so she would never lose it again.

Write a story about: Sue helps a struggling flower by holding her big, red umbrella over it, and they become good friends.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Sue went outside to play. The sun was shining, and the birds were singing. As she played, she saw a small flower on the ground. It was trying to rise up, but the hot sun was making it hard for the flower.
Sue wanted to help the flower. She opened her big, red umbrella and held it over the flower. The flower said, "Thank you, Sue! You are so kind!" Sue smiled and said, "You're welcome, little flower! I'm happy to help!"
The flower began to rise, and soon it was standing tall and strong. Sue and the flower became good friends. They played together every day, and Sue always brought her reliable umbrella to keep the flower safe and happy.

response:

Write a story about: Lucy forgets to clean her room and can no longer see the shapes and pictures on her ceiling at night. She learns the importance of following her mom's instructions and cleans her room the next day, allowing her to see the shapes and pictures again.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Lucy's mom told her to remember to clean her room. But Lucy forgot. She played with her toys and did not clean up. When it was time for bed, Lucy looked up at the ceiling. She could not see the shapes and pictures anymore because her room was too messy.
Lucy felt sad. She knew she needed to remember to clean her room. The next day, she cleaned up all her toys and put them away. That night, when she looked at the ceiling, she could see the shapes and pictures again. Lucy was happy. She learned that it was important to remember to do what her mom asked her to do.
Summary: Lucy forgets to clean her room and can no longer see the shapes and pictures on her ceiling at night. She learns the importance of following her mom's instructions and cleans her room the next day, allowing her to see the shapes and pictures again.
